scope: The distinct eastern supply storehouse in the late nineteenth-century trade group, with timber siding, simple openings, and a raised loading deck.
era: The late Hudson’s Bay Company trading post in 1888.

stories.title: Fort Temiscamingue: Where the Cedars Dance at the Narrows

originalReview.notes: The exact 1876 McLaughlin image from Qualla shows the late trading post’s low gabled timber ensemble. The 1997 excavations name the eastern storehouse. Roy identifies two historical stock buildings as numbers 16 and 17. The 1876 Qualla photo supplies general gable and timber character. Its distant buildings do not independently identify the eastern storehouse.

review.method: Exact Qualla archival photograph and primary archaeological records
